summary: Frontend-only regression for SMARTCLOUT iteration 5: simplified About stat cards, frameless PartnersV2 right column, per-slot independent scatter cycles, pixel-pattern extended to ALL 7 dividers with mint accent for light-light. ALL 12 acceptance items PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: AboutSection.jsx still imports unused useState (line 1). Also PILLARS array's default active state uses hardcoded index PILLARS[1].id — brittle if pillars order changes. Minor cleanup.
SectionDivider now renders 7 × 4096 = 28,672 span nodes for dividers. Consider migrating to <canvas> or SVG <rect> pattern for performance if more dividers are added.

PartnersV2Section pool still keeps duplicates by category (DELL x3, Lenovo x2, Microsoft x2, Huawei x2) — scatter occasionally shows same name twice (e.g. two 'xorux' at t=0, two 'Lenovo' at t=700). Confirm this is desired (visual repetition) vs deduping on p.name.

PartnersV2Section useEffect's cycleSlot recursive setTimeout works correctly, but if hasInteracted flips mid-cycle, some setTimeout callbacks may still fire once before cleanup catches. Not observable in UI (guarded by hasInteracted state check in JSX), but a hasInteractedRef guard inside cycleSlot would be cleaner.
App.css is 3591 lines — splitting into per-section stylesheets (sc-dither.css, sc-statcard.css, sc-partners2.css, sc-rack.css, sc-blueprint.css) is recommended for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Iteration 5 changes VERIFIED on https://web-from-github.preview.emergentagent.com at 1440x900 + 375x812. Key acceptance:
- ALL 7 dividers are .sc-dither (never .sc-blend), each with exactly 4096 cells (COLS=512 × ROWS=8), height=22.5px @ desktop.
- Light↔light dividers (about-trusted, trusted-portfolio, portfolio-sectors) use --sc-bot=rgba(73,173,165,0.14) mint accent → pattern remains visible per screenshot.
- Stat cards are <div> with role=listitem, contain only icon+meta(value+label)+4 brackets. No .sc-statcard__summary, .sc-statcard__detail, .sc-statcard__chevron. No aria-expanded attribute.
- Values: 20+ / 350+ / 130+ with Polish labels (uppercase via CSS text-transform).
- Hover on stat card: transform=matrix(1,0,0,1,4,0) = translateX(4px), iconBg=rgb(12,92,98)=#0C5C62, iconColor=white, glow opacity=1, bracket opacity=1. Background rgb(255,255,255) & border-radius 16px confirmed.
- .sc-partners2 frameless: borderWidth=0px, backgroundColor=rgba(0,0,0,0), padding=0px, borderRadius=0px.
- Scatter independent cycles: at t=0 and t=+700ms, 3 slots changed & 7 stayed (mix confirms per-slot independent timers). Inline animationDuration per span ranges 1183–2913ms — all within 1000–3000ms spec.
- .sc-partners2__scatter height=480px.
- Click rack-slot-security → scatter removed, vendor-security-0=SailPoint, vendor-security-1=baramundi. Click rack-slot-servers → scatter stays gone, vendor-servers-0=DELL. Category switching works.
- Mobile 375x812: 0 horizontal overflow, about grid single 327px column, divider uses --sc-cols-mobile=256 (256 columns), partners section stacks single column. No console errors on desktop or mobile.
